free_tier.stated: 500 free build minutes/month on macOS M2 (individuals). No free storage allowance advertised. Artifact retention is per-team policy; Enterprise default is 1 year.

retention.stated: Artifact retention is now documented: Personal accounts 30 days; Teams on Pay-as-you-go 60 days; Teams on Fixed Annual 1 year; Enterprise 1 year by default; after the period artifacts are automatically deleted.

egress.terms: Free via api.codemagic.io artifact URLs; 'No expiration' download links are a documented option.

record.tooling: POST /artifacts/:secureFilename/public-url with expiresAt, returning a public URL; GET /artifacts/:secureFilename. API token required (`x-auth-token`).
record.chaining: Unlimited accounts x 500 free minutes; artifact volume is bounded by what you can build in 500 min/month. 'No expiration' links mean the URL outlives nothing. The artifact is still deleted by team retention policy.
record.limits_note: 500 min/month free. 'No expiration' applies to the LINK, not the artifact. Retention policy still deletes the file (explicit in their KB). Build dashboards give only 24-hour artifact links.
record.reliability_note: Artifact retention is documented and finite: Personal 30 days, Pay-as-you-go Teams 60 days, Fixed Annual and Enterprise 1 year; a No expiration link stops working once the artifact is removed. 500 free build minutes per month is a hard build ceiling.
